findings.where: Motion sketch, the 'Replay the entrance' control (a button), styled the same as the hero's email link and the article's PDF download link
findings.fault: One look means two different things. A blue underlined line usually takes you somewhere: it opens an email or downloads a file. Here the same look is also used for a button that replays the entrance where you are. Nothing about it tells a visitor it acts in place rather than going somewhere.
findings.who_objects: The founder or Angélique, trying the tile. They would expect 'Replay the entrance' to open a page or a file, as every other blue underlined line does, and would be unsure what it did when the line moved in again. The project also loses a look it could keep for 'this goes somewhere' as the site grows.
